allowed: record a synthetic software unit and SBOM generation context
package a synthetic machine-readable SBOM fragment
map sample fields against a CISA 2026 minimum-elements checklist
name present, partial, missing, and unknown element statuses
produce a client-safe proof-pack summary with named gaps
blocked: claim CISA, federal, or third-party compliance certification
claim the software is free of vulnerabilities
claim KEV absence or exploitability conclusions
claim live customer or production SBOM authenticity
include secrets, credentials, customer records, or live proprietary SBOMs
represent the sample verifier result as a production verification
claim complete AI-SBOM or SaaS multi-tenant coverage
safe_claim_rule: Every buyer-facing claim must distinguish checklist observation on sample artifacts from compliance, vulnerability, exploitability, supplier honesty, or production-build conclusions.
